headline: Every container checked before it is packed.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to one of your plants
heroLede: Pact makes plastic packaging such as pails, bottles, jars and other containers for food, dairy, household and industrial customers. A container with a short shot, flash or the wrong in-mould label stops your customer's filling line, not just yours. This is what a camera check could look like at the end of a moulding line, as an example. We would match it to your own parts. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every container for short shots, flash and cracks that can be seen from outside. A cracked rim is the fault your customer finds when the lid will not seal on their filler.
labelLede: Two in-mould labels for the same customer can look much the same at speed. The camera checks every container carries the right label for the order, straight and complete.
codeLede: The lot code ties every container back to its machine and shift. The system reads it on every container and compares it with the order set at changeover.
objectLede: Sprues, flash and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before containers are stacked and bagged.

vocab.c1h: No short shots, flash or cracks
vocab.alert: Four rims with flash in fifteen minutes on M07. Check the tool.
